title: Self-signed cert fails the connector — issuer trust, not locality
summary: TLS validates the cert issuer against the system trust store regardless of localhost; a self-signed cert is its own untrusted issuer, so clients reject it. mkcert works only because `mkcert -install` adds a trusted local CA (the password step). curl -k masks this by skipping verification; a real connector will not.
